versions.subject: Merge PR #5528 from @MATTANDERS0N - add rules for defense evasion
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Threats\ThreatSeverityDefaultAction\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
        - '\1' # Low severity
        - '\2' # Moderate severity
        - '\4' # High severity
        - '\5' # Severe severity
    Details:
        - 'DWORD (0x00000006)' # Allow
        - 'DWORD (0x00000009)' # NoAction
condition: selection
